digest.component_or_area: CI optionality workflow and parity tests
propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml does no unique work because its 9 tests already run in all four test matrix cells.
A Gerrit Verified run needs 21 concurrent job slots against a GitHub Free cap of 20, so the redundant job's slot cost is unjustified.
Deleting the job is safe because its import-leak checks either spawn fresh subprocesses, parse source via ast, or evict modules and are unaffected by a loaded worker.
Existing parity checks (test_ci_workflow_parity.py and check_verify_gate_parity.py) only inspect caller-level wiring and have no visibility into _optionality.yml inner jobs.
After deletion the only thing keeping the 9 tests running is the incidental lack of pytest markers, which a future edit could silently break.
A durable collection guard must assert the two files collect 9 items under the default selection so a future marker exclusion fails the build.
